description: A single debt's payoff progress bar in the TIER 5 Debt Payoff Progress card. Tokenized, with a color-INDEPENDENT status word so the fill color is never the only signal.

tokens.name: typography.small / colors.text
tokens.fill: gradients.primaryGradient blended toward the status fill color, radius.full

colorIndependence: Progress status conveyed by fill color + the status word (Just started / In progress / On track), not color alone.
developerNotes: The `original = current * 1.3` payoff estimate is synthetic — prefer a real opening-balance field if the debt API exposes one. The bar shows % + status word so a rough estimate never reads as a precise claim.
